ԲԻԴԵՔ ԷՐԵԲՈՒՆԻ (00533652) is a condominium (համատիրություն) for the Erebuni 15/3 building, not a developer. No negative news found.

positives.summary: Listed as a member on developers.am.

Primarily a general contractor that also develops housing. Serious financial-distress signals (Vedi dam loan audit, repeated wage arrears); no bankruptcy filing found.
